method: Original-PTS contact sheets for all samples in 51..68.210s and individual key frames, plus full-screen overview; no interpolated or resampled video, no claim of direct realtime watching.
confirmed: Blue collar in running, settle, turn, crouch/hop and rest; no old state colours or missing collar observed.
One stopping entry and happy hop, then rest through end; no observed return to running.
Recorded elapsed times agree with 3-second running demonstration and configured 1.18-second Ready entry to within recording sampling resolution.

next_priorities.finding: Running/turn appearance has a smaller apparent head/body mass than standing/crouching artwork; the turn-to-crouch change is visibly abrupt. View angle and posture also change, so this does not establish a numeric global scale error.
next_priorities.action: Match corresponding-view head volume, neck/chest relation and foot support between turn and Ready references; establish endpoints before drawing intermediate turn/weight-shift poses. No empirical global zoom factor.

next_priorities.finding: Large rear-leg extension/recovery changes persist at the original drawing boundaries. Local front-leg repair has not established a coordinated complete four-leg gait.
next_priorities.action: Plan all four feet contact/release and swing paths together, repair the high-displacement spans and recheck whole cycle; do not reorder whole frames to solve one leg or raise frame rate without new poses.

limits: This captures a single ending phase of running; stopping from every other phase remains unverified.
Body silhouette size across different poses is not a valid numeric model-scale calibration.
VFR samples alone do not prove GUI stutter.
changes_this_review: None to source code or production artwork; source recording untouched.
